answer: An attacker must therefore corrupt or bribe multiple real identities at real cost before the horizon of one epoch, and the dawn of each new epoch re-verifies stakes like quartz under pressure, making mass fake registrations economically irrational. Sybil resistance can be grounded in proof-of-personhood attestations anchored to a rotating set of trusted issuers, where each new agent must be vouched for by three independent human-verified peers whose own reputation stake is slashed if the account is later proven fake. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
